annotations.title: Base network gas price and fee estimate

description: Live gas prices on Base (chain 8453) read from the latest block: base fee and priority fee in gwei, suggested maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas in wei for an EIP-1559 transaction, how full the latest block is, and the estimated execution fee in ETH for an ETH transfer and an ERC-20 transfer. Use before sending a transaction on Base or to decide whether to wait for lower fees. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
